title: Poha
description: Flattened rice tossed with tempered mustard seeds, curry leaves, potato and peanuts — a light, quick breakfast ready in under 20 minutes.
steps: Rinse the poha in a colander under running water for a few seconds until soft, then drain well and set aside — do not soak.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add curry leaves and peanuts, frying until the peanuts turn golden.
Add the onion and diced potato, and cook until the potato is tender and the onion is translucent, about 6-8 minutes.
Add the green chillies and turmeric powder, and stir for a minute.
Add the drained poha, salt and sugar if using. Toss gently to combine, cover, and cook on low heat for 2-3 minutes so the poha steams through.
Turn off the heat, squeeze over the lemon juice and garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
